shot: Studio product photograph of {subject}. It stands upright on its own, centred in the frame, seen straight on at eye level, the whole object about 60% of the frame height, with generous empty space above, below and on both sides. Plain seamless mid-grey studio backdrop and floor, soft even light from above, a faint soft contact shadow under it. Photorealistic, crisp material detail. No text, no logos, no other objects.
turn: Turntable shot. The object slowly rotates in place, as if on a hidden turntable, through one full 360-degree turn at a steady, even speed, always turning the same way, and ends exactly as it started. The camera is locked off: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. The backdrop, floor and light stay exactly the same. The object keeps its exact shape, size, colours and details throughout.
